about.title: About the Paldea Evolved set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Paldea Evolved is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 9 June 2023. It has 279 cards: 193 in the main set and 86 secret rares. There are also 176 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 193 main set cards), the Master set (369 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 455 cards, adding the 86 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
